scope: Prevent repeated request verification on unchanged source within an edit attempt
behavior: Repeated build or browser-check calls return the saved failed request diagnostics for the same revision
No extra build, browser run, or repair-budget increment for a reused result
Successful source patch clears verification state
A new attempt can rerun verification; compiler and baseline failures are not cached
verification: Worker integration test uses a scripted provider to request build, repeated build, repeated browser check, patch, and build. It asserts two builds and checks, one failed-repair count, both reuse events, and successful post-patch verification.
limits: Scripted-provider evidence does not prove Bonsai changes its tool choices
No live model performance improvement claimed
No human acceptance or new verified MongoDB backup
